title: Shakira's Madrid Concert Sets an Amazon Music Livestream Record
summary:
Shakira's concert in Madrid on October 3 has become the most-viewed livestream by a female artist on Amazon Music so far. Amazon Music shared the news on Sunday, October 4, the day after the Colombian superstar's show was broadcast live.

The concert was part of Shakira's 12-date residency in Madrid, Spain, on her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour. She performed at Shakira Stadium, a temporary venue built in Madrid's Iberdrola Music complex just for the residency. It opened on September 18 and finishes with its 12th show on October 11.

Her set included hits from three decades of her career in Latin music. There was also a surprise. Pop singer Dua Lipa came onstage and sang an acoustic version of "Antología" with Shakira. The song is from Shakira's 1997 album Pies Descalzos. Shakira said the moment was "what this tour was missing."

"For me, it's an honor and a privilege to sing this song, which means so much to me, with this woman who is so admired and loved around the world," Shakira told the crowd of more than 50,000 fans. People at home could also watch the duet through the livestream on Amazon Music, Prime Video and Twitch.

After the show, Dua Lipa wrote on Instagram in Spanish that she felt she, Shakira and the audience "were one." She said she was grateful to take home such a beautiful memory.

Amazon Music's livestream of Saturday night's concert led its 2026 Women Shaping Latin Music campaign. The campaign celebrates the artists, sounds and cultural movements shaping Latin music.
why_it_matters: Livestreams let fans around the world share big musical moments, and this record shows growing interest in female artists' online shows.
